# std.num

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Numeric conversions and explicit checked/wrapping arithmetic.

`Target.from(value)` exists only for lossless conversions;
`Target.try_from(value)` checks the value fits. Ordinary operators are
checked (overflow is a task defect); `checked_*` helpers return `Result`
and `wrapping_*` helpers compute modulo 2^bits.
One block per integer type (the blocks are alike: change them together).

